verses.english: The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti—
verses.english: A noble disciple comes to truly understand these five faculties’ gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
verses.english: Such a noble disciple is called a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”
